pillars.title: Catchment Areas
pillars.description: Pastor leaders coordinate transformation across a cluster of neighbouring communities — the bridge between country strategy and community action.

pillars.title: Shalom Groups
pillars.description: Each community develops Shalom groups of 30–50 leaders who drive discipleship, cohesion, and local initiative.

pillars.title: 2-Year Transformation Journey
pillars.description: Every community progresses through a structured two-year journey from Awareness to Multiplication — tracked in the community tracking system.

pillars.title: Community-Led Development
pillars.description: Pastor-Planned Projects (PPPs) and Church-initiated Projects (CHIPs) are community-owned initiatives — water, agriculture, livelihood, and more.

pillars.title: Triple-A Leadership
pillars.description: Pastor leaders develop through Awareness (vision), Ability (skills), and Action (implementation) — measured via leadership scores and engagement.

pillars.title: Resource Mobilization
pillars.description: Communities mobilise local resources and partnerships. The platform tracks mobilization to guide where support is most needed.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.description: PPP & CHIP projects active; measurable outcomes

hero.title: About Us
hero.lead: Interactive storytelling and data on pastor-led transformation across Africa — leadership, discipleship, livelihoods, youth, and community development.

intro.title: The ministry model behind the data
intro.text: Which communities are progressing fastest, and where is support most needed? This atlas puts transformation at its centre — tracking how pastor-led communities advance across five results areas, from their own starting points, through a structured two-year journey from continent to household.

acknowledgements.title: About this platform
acknowledgements.text: The PA Transformation Intelligence platform was designed to reflect how Possibilities Africa organises ministry on the ground — from continent to community. Data visualisations and stories are mock content for frontend demonstration; backend API integration points are marked throughout.
